title: Semi-Classical Localization of the Schrödinger Resolvent on Closed Riemann Surfaces
summary: This paper investigates the localization properties of solutions to the semi-classical Schrödinger equation on closed Riemann surfaces. Unlike classical studies that assume a smooth potential, our work addresses the challenges arising from irregular potentials, specifically those that are merely bounded. We employ a regularization technique to manage the potential's lack of smoothness and establish a local-to-global estimate.
